decisions.statement: Every host the route map names is a peripheral of alanwalton.com.
A peripheral is named by the first label of the host it answers on.
Every host behind the proxy signs its cookies with one key.
A contributor the environment does not name reaches nothing behind the proxy.
A caller signed in as somebody not named is refused rather than sent round to sign in again.

definition: which caller a host's handover cookie proves a request is from
